verdict.rationale: Vanta documents a manual-evidence path: evidence files can be attached to a Vanta document and submitted for review (vanta-docs-31). The API can upload documents and bulk-assign owners to resources (vanta-docs-23), and a specific user can be made accountable for a control (vanta-docs-30). The reminder automation in vanta-docs-22 is about risk assessments, so it does not transfer to document renewal. Missing for 10: per-artifact due dates, renewal reminders, expiry tracking on manual evidence, explicit document-owner workflow docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
